title: Tor'kren Farm
wikitext:
[[File:Torkren_Farm.jpg|thumb|Tor'kren Farm]]

Located near [[Thunder Ridge]] in northwestern [[Durotar]], '''Tor'kren Farm''' hasn't seen as much profit as other [[pig farm]]s in the area. Previously run by [[Misha Tor'kren]] and her son, the fate of the farm is uncertain after the younger orc ventured out to hunt [[crocolisk]]s at the [[Southfury River]].
